hypothesis: Core residency reduces complete normal conversation time by limiting the initial-generation stalls observed in the diagnostic.
expected_effect: Lower initial and retained-append latency at equal memory, without changing outputs, arithmetic or expert cache policy. The gate was recorded before timing.
controlled_change: Only residency off versus core in two fresh-process alternating pairs, with CLOCK, reference kernels, the mixed artifact, 12GiB and 1,848 expert slots. Each conversation has a 72-token prompt, 33 outputs, 128-token append and 33 outputs. Diagnostics and Metal validation disabled.
correctness: 173 Python tests passed. Native build unchanged from the earlier 56 tests and 45,682 assertions with Metal validation. All eight real requests matched prior control output IDs; each append reused 104 computed tokens. Equal memory and core-only residency enrollment checked at phase/request boundaries. No new full-logit/state or coding-quality proof.
outcome: Normal conversation core/off ratios 0.950602 and 0.939421: 4.94 and 6.06 percent lower latency. Both initial and append requests improved overall, passing the declared repeatability and regression gate. Each conversation had identical 30,264 expert misses. Core generation about 2.5 tokens/s; append first-token wait about 24 seconds. Completed in 273.52 seconds.
smallest_experiment: Five alternating paired normal conversations at equal configuration and budget, with a declared deadline and paired uncertainty estimates, before longer qualification. Preserve CLOCK and residency-off defaults; report memory activity and separate startup from subsequent generation.
limitations: Only two alternating pairs; no confidence interval or production promotion.
72-token initial prompt and 128-token append to short live history; not the 2K/4K/7K acceptance workloads or sustained coding session.
Output parity is not a new full-logit/state comparison or independent coding-quality evaluation. Weights and native arithmetic are unchanged.
Memory snapshots are boundary observations, not continuous peaks. System counters include other processes.
Core residency is requested through Metal, not guaranteed. Host memory pressure and SSD caching remain uncontrolled influences.
Phase-level decompressions cannot identify the exact page or token causing a wait. Overlapping read, GPU and CPU timings are not additive.
Diagnostic and normal results use different observations and must not be pooled as equivalent repetitions.
